tagline: Employee self-service for payslips, leave, and HR documents
problem: HR teams email payslips and answer the same leave questions repeatedly.
solution: Payroll Portal gives employees a secure portal for payslips, leave requests, and HR documents synced with Odoo HR.

features.title: Portal Home
features.text: Dashboard for payslips, leave balance, and requests.

features.title: Payslip Access
features.text: PDF payslips when HR Payroll is available.

features.title: Leave Requests
features.text: Submit and track time off from the portal.

features.title: Access Control
features.text: Portal security separate from backend groups.

seo_keywords: Odoo payroll portal, employee self-service, payslip portal, Odoo HR
